claim_boundary: Static schema, identity, envelope-join, transition and projection-value fixtures only. No family is admitted, no checkpoint moves, and no native producer, append path, projector, reader, durability, deletion or seal is proved; every native obligation is NOT_RUN.

evaluation.schema: Draft 2020-12 validation against the payload or projection definition, with the payload, projection, collaborative workflows contracts and event record index checkpoint schemas registered by $id and no remote retrieval. format is not asserted.

static_rules.valid_utc_datetime: Every family timestamp is a real calendar date and time (CV-460).
static_rules.identity_recipe: owner_operation_id is collabop_ plus the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 array [event_type, scope_partition, subject..., recovery_epoch]; idempotency_key is collaboration@1:{owner_operation_id} in project scope and application@1:{hex(server_id)}:{hex(owner_operation_id)} in application scope (CV-366); event_id is evt_collaboration_ plus the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 array [storage_instance_id, recovery_epoch, scope_partition, event_type, subject...] (SP-460).
static_rules.review_counts: artifact_finalized's completed plus failed reviewer counts equal requested_reviewer_count (CV-478).

transition_sequences.description: A Crew run: created and started, two attempts, messages with a sequence gap refused, an artifact, both outcomes and completion; a message after completion is refused.
Pause and resume rules, a cancel refused while an attempt is open, the fence's canceled outcome, the cancel, and a resume after the terminal event.
A run stopped at its own cost limit settles cancelled with stop_reason limit_cost; a failure after it is refused.
A participant failure is a participant outcome; the run's own failure is collaboration.failed, once.
A failed required slot blocks completion until a recorded waiver; the waiver outcome without its reconfigure is refused.
created once at revision 1, a reconfigure to revision 2, a stale revision refused, and a re-run whose Start commits revision 3 before its own start.
An outcome for an unknown attempt, a second start of the same attempt, a second outcome, a retry under the same assignment revision and a replacement that raises it.
Core proposals, a Wonderer refused as proposer and voter, an unknown proposal, a superseded attempt's vote, one synthesis, and completion that needs the Plan.
A BrainStorm proposal naming a Crew run's identity fails the run's lineage.
A wrong-pack finding refused, an unknown finding, one disposition, finalization refused before its artifact and while partial, accept_partial as a waiver, then one finalization and completion.
finish_stale: a reconfigure with accept_stale_target, then a finalization that discloses the stale pack; a second finalization of the same run is refused.
A Review cannot complete without its finalized artifact.
End discussion settles a paused Chat Room completed; a predicate completion of a paused run is not admitted.
An application-scope run in the app partition; a Project event for the same run identity is a different partition and finds no started run.
With only the run lifecycle core admitted, a message and a BrainStorm proposal are quarantined before append; nothing is inferred from them.

required_native_oracles.given: A Start admission that commits a new definition and run
required_native_oracles.required_result: The definition and run records commit with their prepared events; collaboration.created then collaboration.started append with first receipts; CollaborationStartResult is committed only after the started receipt; no card or Activity entry appears before it

required_native_oracles.given: A repeated Start with the same command idempotency binding, and a lost append acknowledgement for any admitted family
required_native_oracles.required_result: The original run, event and receipt return through storage.first_append_receipt.resolve.v2; no second run, event or first mint

required_native_oracles.given: An uncertain append of a run's event
required_native_oracles.required_result: The run is fenced: no later event of that run appends until Storage resolves the original identity

required_native_oracles.given: A crash after an owner commit and before its event's first receipt
required_native_oracles.required_result: Restart finds the committed record's prepared event, resolves or retries only that original identity, and never mints a new one; an in-flight attempt gets exactly one terminal outcome

required_native_oracles.given: Pause and resume of a running run, and a quota reset while paused
required_native_oracles.required_result: paused appends when the safe boundary is reached; resumed only on cmd.collaboration.resume; a quota reset or scheduled window never resumes it

required_native_oracles.given: Cancel of a run with open attempts and a late participant result
required_native_oracles.required_result: Every open attempt closes canceled before collaboration.cancelled; the late result appends nothing and changes no card

required_native_oracles.given: A run whose last provider turn finished while a required slot is unresolved
required_native_oracles.required_result: No collaboration.completed until the required slot completes or is waived and the kind's output exists

required_native_oracles.given: A run settled failed by its owner, and a coordinator failure
required_native_oracles.required_result: collaboration.failed with the section 11 reason for the run; a coordinator failure appends no run event and leaves the run in attention

required_native_oracles.given: Two slots on the same model, a retry and a replacement
required_native_oracles.required_result: Distinct attempt IDs and started events; the retry keeps the assignment revision, the replacement raises it; each attempt gets one outcome

required_native_oracles.given: A streamed helper message that completes, one that is cancelled, and a replayed completion
required_native_oracles.required_result: One message_added for the written message with the next sequence; nothing for the cancelled one and no gap; the replay writes nothing

required_native_oracles.given: A Review artifact created by the artifact owner, then the chat deleted
required_native_oracles.required_result: artifact_added then artifact_finalized; deleting the chat removes the events and never purges the shared artifact

required_native_oracles.given: A reconfigure that waives a slot, and a stale expected revision
required_native_oracles.required_result: configuration_changed then message_added for the system entry; the stale one is refused and appends nothing

required_native_oracles.given: A participant read during a blind proposal or blind review phase
required_native_oracles.required_result: No proposal or finding event exists yet, and no reader discloses another participant's existence metadata

required_native_oracles.given: A Wonderer vote attempt and a vote from a superseded attempt
required_native_oracles.required_result: Both refused; tallies count only current core attempts

required_native_oracles.given: Two synthesis requests for one BrainStorm run
required_native_oracles.required_result: One Plan, one plan_synthesized; the second returns the original result

required_native_oracles.given: A Multi-Pass Review with one failed reviewer, then accept_partial
required_native_oracles.required_result: No finalization until the waiver is recorded; the artifact says partial coverage; a single reviewer is a single-pass result

required_native_oracles.given: A projector advance whose checkpoint changed after it was read
required_native_oracles.required_result: Prior-value compare-and-swap fails; no row or checkpoint advances

required_native_oracles.given: A checkpoint advance, read and recovery
required_native_oracles.required_result: The stored nine-field durable token is joined to the live read's redb_snapshot_id and revalidated whole

required_native_oracles.given: An event of a family that is not admitted
required_native_oracles.required_result: Quarantined before append; no checkpoint advance; no sibling state inferred

required_native_oracles.given: A read while the checkpoint is not current, coverage is short or the publication changed
required_native_oracles.required_result: Typed unavailable; no fallback to older rows

required_native_oracles.given: Withdrawal of one admitted family
required_native_oracles.required_result: Writer cut off, current core withdrawn, readers fenced, governed rebuild from kept seglog records; no deletion

required_native_oracles.given: Deletion of the chat a run belongs to, with and without a hold
required_native_oracles.required_result: Content-free tombstone at once; unheld active copies purged within 24 hours and deleted backup bytes within 30 days; a hold delays physical purge but never restores visibility; projection rows of that chat's runs are removed

required_native_oracles.given: An application-scope run before the owner adopts the app source graph
required_native_oracles.required_result: No application payload is appended (requires_owner_adoption); the Project path is unaffected
